body:
Hmm, it should be "code units" instead of "code points", but otherwise accurate. 

The ES2015 features in Node 4 aren't complete, so we can't remove this warning or make other code changes.
@nzakas Should I make a PR with "code points" replaced by "code units"? And my be "available in Node.js" could be replaced by "available in Node.js LTS"?
@vsemozhetbyt I don't think we should change it to "available in Node.js LTS" because we will continue supporting Node 4 for the foreseeable future.
@kaicataldo Got it. And what about "code points" -> "code units"?
Sounds like @nzakas is on board - I say go for it :) Here's some more info on making a PR: http://eslint.org/docs/developer-guide/contributing/pull-requests. Thanks for contributing!
